competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and increases the chances of the enemy to land a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 30% chance on each strike.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to remove 1 beneficial effect granted on them and to increase the skill cooldown time by 1 turn each with a 70% chance each.

effets.description: Puts the target's skill on cool down.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

competences.description: With the power of a piercing gaze, decreases the chance of allies being granted with harmful effects by 30% and increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 10% if an ally is not granted with harmful effects due to [Discernment (Passive)]. In addition, increases the duration of harmful effects, excluding inability effects, that allies grant on enemies by 1 turn each. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Increases the duration of one or more debuffs on the enemy
effets.note: Increase debuff duration applied to enemies

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: if an ally is not granted with harmful effects due to [Discernment (Passive)]
